svg.data-fans: 3x hot-swappable 2+1 redundant, exhaust airflow; system front-to-back
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1 default, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with additional licence; T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC), Class C accuracy
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations, enabling a T-GM source at the cell site without additional equipment
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-nos: NOS integration is necessary to activate the timing features
svg.data-optics-sfp: 1G SFP SX, LX, EX, ZX (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER, ZR (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-bmc-role: individual BMC for automatic and remote platform health monitoring
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55035; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI

g.data-description: HIG GNSS row - Off (GNSS not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not complete), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground). Every row but Solid Yellow is annotated "need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source such as GNSS, 1PPS, PTP or BITS), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG STAT row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (system boot complete under the NOS), Blinking Green (system is booting), Solid Yellow (system boot complete under the DIAG OS). The yellow row is this family's difference from the S9510-28DC, whose table has none
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (all fan modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fan modules fail or no fan module present)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PWR row - Off (no power or shutdown), Solid Green (system power good, BMC present and BMC power good), Blinking Green (system power good, BMC present but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but BMC absent), Blinking Yellow (system power fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-mgmt-l: HIG Management port LED table, Left LED - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt-r: HIG Management port LED table, Right LED - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, which is why each is declared on its own
g.title: mgmt

circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (PSU DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to this PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
